name: EdgeDesk Simulator — NCAA men's tournament (correlated bracket simulation)
hypothesis: Simulating the official bracket 100,000 times from the NCAAM pregame forecast, with one persistent latent strength draw per team per run (variance measured from frozen-rating residual covariance) and each game drawn from the same coherent distribution, gives calibrated probabilities of reaching each round and winning the title.
objective: Calibrated advancement probabilities after the official field is announced; never a recommendation and never a bracket-pool pick.
primary_metric: Brier score of reach-R32, Sweet 16, Elite 8, Final Four, title game and title probabilities over every entrant of the holdout tournaments, frozen before the First Four; log loss clipped at max(1e-6, 0.5/N).
unit: One tournament (season). The 64-68 entrants and 63-67 games of one tournament are NOT independent: every interval is a season bootstrap.
baseline: The same simulator with V = 0 (no persistent strength draw); and, where captured, same-time futures prices.
training_window: Strength variance from frozen-rating residuals of 2012-2025 (validation/strength_uncertainty.json, 2024-2026 NCAA tournament games excluded).
holdout_window: Tournaments 2027, 2028 and 2029, each frozen before its First Four and scored once after its final. The 2024-2026 tournaments were scored once on 2026-10-23 (V vs V = 0, reported) and are not used to choose anything.

machine.window_note: [from, to): dates of the seasons inside each window

minimum_sample.note: One tournament is very little evidence; below three holdout tournaments the record is descriptive and no result row is written.

promotion_criteria.decision_rule: passed = true only if every criterion holds on the holdout tournaments. A criterion that cannot be evaluated is not met.

criteria.rule: Pooled advancement Brier no worse than the V = 0 simulator by more than 0.0005 (season bootstrap upper bound).
Every probability band with n >= 30 within 0.08 of its observed rate, pooled over holdout tournaments.
Same-time futures comparison on >= 100 matched outcomes, interval below 0 (NOT EVALUABLE until futures quotes are captured).

candidates_tried.strength: one persistent normal offset per team, V from 1 March frozen-rating residual covariance
candidates_tried.evaluated_against_outcomes: the backtest compares V and V = 0 descriptively; V was not tuned to tournament outcomes

alternatives_considered_not_tried: V from a freeze at Selection Sunday (horizon-matched; too few post-freeze games per team for a stable estimate — the documented next study)
a hot-form carry-over between rounds (no validation evidence: not built)

spec.engine: simulator/src/core (xoshiro128** seeded by SplitMix64; per-run streams)
spec.module: simulator/src/sports/ncaam/module.ts over bracket.ts slots (First Four, fixed paths, no reseeding)
known_limitations: every tournament game neutral; proximity not modelled
conference tournaments not simulated without verified formats
